resources.string: Battery Info
Let the AI read device battery status, level, and charging info
Brightness
Let the AI read and adjust screen brightness. Requires WRITE_SETTINGS permission for setting brightness.
Flashlight
Let the AI turn the device flashlight on or off
Vibrate
Let the AI trigger device vibration with custom duration or pattern
Volume Control
Let the AI read and adjust audio volume for media, ring, notification, alarm, etc.
Wake Screen
Let the AI wake up the screen when it is off
WiFi Info
Let the AI read current WiFi connection info (SSID, signal, IP). Requires location permission.
Phone Info
Let the AI read SIM card and carrier information. Requires READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
Storage Info
Let the AI read internal and external storage usage
Toast
Let the AI show brief toast popup notifications on screen
Post Notification
Let the AI send system notifications. Requires notification permission.
Share
Let the AI open the system share sheet with text or URLs
Media Scanner
Let the AI trigger media file scanning so files appear in gallery apps
